title: Keris Aman 23 | The Impact of Proper EOD Procedures
description: Canadian Armed Forces SGT David Scott and team instructs a class of MAF EOD technicians on the construction and proper detonation of IEDs and unexploded ordinance in a field training exercise during Keris Aman 23. Keris Aman is designed to strengthen military-to-military relationships and enhance the core PKO competencies of all participants in accordance with UN doctrine. (Video by Petty Officer Victoria Schiebel and A1C Caroline Strickland)
keywords: KerisAman23 Malaysia United Nations Canada EOD

transcript.text: We're teaching the three main
components of the Malaysian military .
So we have Navy Air Force and army all
here . They are all qualified eu D
technicians . So we're going to start
off . We'll go through like a walk
through , talk through , showing them
how to make it what it's good and
effective against us . As instructors
will make one , we'll take them down
range , place it aside of target or
something . Explain to them how we're
doing it and what we're targeting ,
we'll come back , we'll set it off ,
we'll take them back down , show them
what the effect it had and then we'll
give them the opportunity to build
their own and do the same thing we just
did . Obviously , the ID threat is very
pertinent around the world no matter
where they're going . So even if
they're in a peace keeping operation ,
there's going to be an ID threat and
the methods that we're teaching them
today are methods that they can get the
materials they need anywhere they go in
the world . It's not something they're
going to rely on like a supply system
to supply them that will always have
these things and they can safely do
their job .
